To be perfectly honest, I think this candidate is a bit pathetic. I understand that you are good friends with the candidate, and I am not writing this email to insult or harm them. However, I believe that honesty and transparency are important in the hiring process, and I want you to be aware of my thoughts and feelings about this candidate. Please let me know if you have any questions or concerns. Thank you for your time and understanding.

Best regards,
